legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this Chapter, unless the context otherwise requires,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. For the purposes of this Chapter, unless the context otherwise requires,—

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "accommodating party" means a party to an arrangement, if the main purpose of the direct or indirect participation of that party in the arrangement, in whole or in part, is to obtain, directly or indirectly, a tax benefit (but for the provisions of this Chapter) for the assessee whether or not the party is a connected person in relation to any party to the arrangement;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(1): "accommodating party" means a party to an arrangement, if the main purpose of the direct or indirect participation of that party in the arrangement, in whole or in part, is to obtain, directly or indirectly, a tax benefit (but for the provisions of this Chapter) for the assessee whether or not the party is a connected person in relation to any party to the arrangement;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "arrangement" means any step in, or a part or whole of, any transaction, operation, scheme, agreement or understanding, whether enforceable or not, and includes the alienation of any property in such transaction, operation, scheme, agreement or understanding;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(2): "arrangement" means any step in, or a part or whole of, any transaction, operation, scheme, agreement or understanding, whether enforceable or not, and includes the alienation of any property in such transaction, operation, scheme, agreement or understanding;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "asset" includes property, or right, of any kind;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(3): "asset" includes property, or right, of any kind;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "benefit" includes a payment of any kind whether in tangible or intangible form;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(4): "benefit" includes a payment of any kind whether in tangible or intangible form;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,—

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: any relative of the person, if such person is an individual;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(a): any relative of the person, if such person is an individual;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: any director of the company or any relative of such director, if the person is a company;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(b): any director of the company or any relative of such director, if the person is a company;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: any partner or member of a firm or association of persons or body of individuals or any relative of such partner or member, if the person is a firm or association of persons or body of individuals;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(c): any partner or member of a firm or association of persons or body of individuals or any relative of such partner or member, if the person is a firm or association of persons or body of individuals;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: any member of the Hindu undivided family or any relative of such member, if the person is a Hindu undivided family;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(d): any member of the Hindu undivided family or any relative of such member, if the person is a Hindu undivided family;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: any individual who has a substantial interest in the business of the person or any relative of such individual;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(e): any individual who has a substantial interest in the business of the person or any relative of such individual;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a company, firm or an association of persons or a body of individuals, whether incorporated or not, or a Hindu undivided family having a substantial interest in the business of the person or any director, partner, or member of the company, firm or association of persons or body of individuals or family, or any relative of such director, partner or member;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(f): a company, firm or an association of persons or a body of individuals, whether incorporated or not, or a Hindu undivided family having a substantial interest in the business of the person or any director, partner, or member of the company, firm or association of persons or body of individuals or family, or any relative of such director, partner or member;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a company, firm or association of persons or body of individuals, whether incorporated or not, or a Hindu undivided family, whose director, partner, or member has a substantial interest in the business of the person, or family or any relative of such director, partner or member;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(g): a company, firm or association of persons or body of individuals, whether incorporated or not, or a Hindu undivided family, whose director, partner, or member has a substantial interest in the business of the person, or family or any relative of such director, partner or member;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: any other person who carries on a business, if—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(h): any other person who carries on a business, if—

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: the person being an individual, or any relative of such person, has a substantial interest in the business of that other person; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(h): any other person who carries on a business, if— Section 184(5)(h)(i): the person being an individual, or any relative of such person, has a substantial interest in the business of that other person; or

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: the person being a company, firm, association of persons, body of individuals, whether incorporated or not, or a Hindu undivided family, or any director, partner or member of such company, firm or association of persons or body of individuals or family, or any relative of such director, partner or member, has a substantial interest in the business of that other person;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(5): "connected person" means any person who is connected directly or indirectly to another person and includes,— Section 184(5)(h): any other person who carries on a business, if— Section 184(5)(h)(ii): the person being a company, firm, association of persons, body of individuals, whether incorporated or not, or a Hindu undivided family, or any director, partner or member of such company, firm or association of persons or body of individuals or family, or any relative of such director, partner or member, has a substantial interest in the business of that other person;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "fund" includes—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(6): "fund" includes—

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: any cash;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(6): "fund" includes— Section 184(6)(a): any cash;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: cash equivalents; and
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(6): "fund" includes— Section 184(6)(b): cash equivalents; and

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: any right, or obligation, to receive or pay, the cash or cash equivalent;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(6): "fund" includes— Section 184(6)(c): any right, or obligation, to receive or pay, the cash or cash equivalent;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "party" includes a person or a permanent establishment which participates or takes part in an arrangement;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(7): "party" includes a person or a permanent establishment which participates or takes part in an arrangement;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "relative" shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 92(5)(g);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(8): "relative" shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 92(5)(g);

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a person shall be deemed to have a substantial interest in the business, if,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(9): a person shall be deemed to have a substantial interest in the business, if,—

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: in a case where the business is carried on by a company, such person is, at any time during the financial year, the beneficial owner of equity shares carrying at least 20% of the voting power; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(9): a person shall be deemed to have a substantial interest in the business, if,— Section 184(9)(a): in a case where the business is carried on by a company, such person is, at any time during the financial year, the beneficial owner of equity shares carrying at least 20% of the voting power; or

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: in any other case, such person is, at any time during the financial year, beneficially entitled to at least 20% of the profits of such business;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(9): a person shall be deemed to have a substantial interest in the business, if,— Section 184(9)(b): in any other case, such person is, at any time during the financial year, beneficially entitled to at least 20% of the profits of such business;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "step" includes a measure or an action, particularly one of a series taken in order to deal with or achieve a particular thing or object in the arrangement;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(10): "step" includes a measure or an action, particularly one of a series taken in order to deal with or achieve a particular thing or object in the arrangement;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "tax benefit" includes,— in the relevant tax year or any other tax year;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(11): "tax benefit" includes,— in the relevant tax year or any other tax year;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a reduction or avoidance or deferral of tax or other amount payable under this Act; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(11): "tax benefit" includes,— in the relevant tax year or any other tax year; Section 184(11)(a): a reduction or avoidance or deferral of tax or other amount payable under this Act; or

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: an increase in a refund of tax or other amount under this Act; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(11): "tax benefit" includes,— in the relevant tax year or any other tax year; Section 184(11)(b): an increase in a refund of tax or other amount under this Act; or

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a reduction or avoidance or deferral of tax or other amount that would be payable under this Act, as a result of a tax treaty; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(11): "tax benefit" includes,— in the relevant tax year or any other tax year; Section 184(11)(c): a reduction or avoidance or deferral of tax or other amount that would be payable under this Act, as a result of a tax treaty; or

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: an increase in a refund of tax or other amount under this Act as a result of a tax treaty; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(11): "tax benefit" includes,— in the relevant tax year or any other tax year; Section 184(11)(d): an increase in a refund of tax or other amount under this Act as a result of a tax treaty; or

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a reduction in total income; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(11): "tax benefit" includes,— in the relevant tax year or any other tax year; Section 184(11)(e): a reduction in total income; or

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: an increase in loss,
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(11): "tax benefit" includes,— in the relevant tax year or any other tax year; Section 184(11)(f): an increase in loss,

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: "tax treaty" means an agreement referred to in section 159(1) or (2).
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 184 Interpretation. Section 184(12): "tax treaty" means an agreement referred to in section 159(1) or (2).
